integrity: The classification is proved by an exact unimodular change of valuation coordinates followed by elimination of the two composite-factorial generator coefficients. The packaged verifier independently recomputes all factorial valuation vectors through 16! and stress-tests the resulting criterion against direct coefficient search.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the largest-prime-13 stratum; no claim is made about support 17 or larger. A broad 1976 products-of-factorials paper remains a residual literature-risk source despite inspection of its stated scope and sampled full-text pages.
title: Exact largest-prime-\(13\) classification of Jordan–Pólya numbers
